## Description
The Soy Pulp consisting of insoluble parts of the soybean which&#10;&#9;&#9; after pureed Soybean are filtered in the production of soymilk and tofu.

## Characteristics

| Attribute      | Value |
|--------:|:------|
|Edible:|true|
|Type:|Soy Based|
|Form:|Solid|
